status: Complete 2026-11-17 (Successful; referee pending): a knot pattern grows an exact order one betweenness knot at a time, and its own states name where the next knot must go. The grown line is pairwise and an exact ruler; statically, box betweenness on a grid holds two independent orders. 8 of 8 frozen predictions held.
